entries.changes: The My agents page can now sort agent cards by release date (default, newest first), alphabetically, or by type. All agent cards are now the same size.

Added a My agents page. Select your agents, then choose the Drive Disc sets and Disc 4, 5 and 6 main stats you plan to use for each. The Drive Disc Sets page now uses those choices for its Keep / Remove view and stat lists.
Builds are now available for all 62 agents. Agent lists and "ranked on" chips use in-game names (for example Anby, Miyabi and Lucy); full names remain on each agent page, and search matches both.

Added Severian Lowell and builds for 53 of 62 agents, all from Prydwen. Drive Disc sets and W-Engines were refreshed from Prydwen (103 W-Engines, 30 sets) with bundled images. Off-specialty W-Engines are allowed as stat sticks, agents are sorted by release date, and substat PEN is now Flat PEN.
Initial release with the full agent roster, Drive Discs, W-Engines, and the Hoshimi Miyabi DPS build.
